[[File:Fruits.png|thumb|250px]]

The exotic '''shuura''' [[fruit]] was yellow and cream colored, with a juicy, sweet taste. The fruit was a favorite of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. While at [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] she shared one with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

Shuura fruit flavour syrup was used as a flavouring for [[Fizzyglug]] in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Behind the scenes==
Other fruits appearing in the scene include a [[Wikipedia:Pineapple|pineapple]], an [[Wikipedia:Orange (fruit)|orange]], and a [[Wikipedia:Carambola|starfruit]].
